episodes.title: Inside America's Hidden Sex Trafficking Networks — Cynthia Clack on 'Discovering the Club
episodes.description: In this eye-opening episode, attorney and author Cynthia Clack joins us to discuss her book "Discovering the Club" — a deeply researched exposé into ritualistic abuse, sex trafficking, and corruption within America's justice system. Drawing on her legal background, Cynthia walks us through disturbing real-world case studies, including satanic cult activity and organized child abuse networks in Texas. We discuss how organized crime intersects with child exploitation, why so many of these cases are buried or dismissed by the courts, and how systemic corruption — even in wealthy counties — has allowed predators to remain protected for years. This conversation isn't easy to hear, but it's necessary. Cynthia shares what she's learned from working directly with survivors and victims, why children's testimonies are so often dismissed despite their credibility, and what it will take — individually and societally — to confront and end this cycle of abuse. If you care about child protection, justice system reform, and shining a light on hidden crimes, this is an episode you need to hear. 📖 Get Cynthia Clack's book "Discovering the Club" ⚠️ Content Warning: This episode contains discussion of child abuse, ritual abuse, and sex trafficking.
